assumptions.choice: Market filter's '200-period SMA on a higher timeframe (e.g., daily chart)' is built by manually aggregating the fixed 1h feed into synthetic daily closes (last close observed before each date change) and computing a 200-period SMA on that series.
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies a single 1h AAPL data feed; no daily feed or cerebro-level resampling is available to the strategy class, so a true daily SMA can't be added. This is the closest literal, data-driven reading.

assumptions.choice: Run all logic on the harness's fixed 1h bars rather than the spec's intended 4H/D1 charts.
assumptions.reason: The execution environment fixes the data feed and timeframe; the strategy code has no way to change it.

assumptions.choice: Use self.broker.getvalue() (current total portfolio equity) as 'Total Capital' in the risk/size formula.
assumptions.reason: Spec doesn't specify fixed starting cash vs. live equity; mark-to-market equity is the standard basis for ongoing 1%-risk sizing.

assumptions.choice: Use abs(Entry Price - Stop Loss Price) as the denominator.
assumptions.reason: The literal formula (Entry - Stop) is negative for shorts since the stop sits above entry, producing a nonsensical negative size; abs() preserves the intended 1%-risk sizing for both directions.

assumptions.choice: Approximate 'Entry Price' in the sizing formula with the signal bar's close.
assumptions.reason: Entries are market orders filled at the next bar's open, so the true fill price is unknown at the moment size must be computed; close is the best available proxy.

assumptions.choice: Truncate computed size to an integer share count via int().
assumptions.reason: Backtrader stock orders require whole-share sizes; spec is silent on fractional shares.

assumptions.choice: Allow at most one retest add-on per breakout trade (guarded by a retest_done flag).
assumptions.reason: Spec describes a single retest step; unlimited re-adds aren't stated and would violate the baseline single-position rule beyond the one explicit exception.

assumptions.choice: Apply the 200-SMA trend filter only to initial breakout entries, not to the retest add-on.
assumptions.reason: The filter is stated in terms of 'long trades'/'short trades' direction, already validated when the breakout leg opened; the retest is additive to that same trade.

assumptions.choice: Use backtrader's self.position.price (running average cost) as 'entry price'/'break-even' for the trailing-stop calculation.
assumptions.reason: After a retest add-on the position has a blended cost basis; this is the standard accessible value representing current break-even.

assumptions.choice: Implement the trailing stop as a single one-time move from the initial stop to break-even + 1 ATR the first bar the position becomes profitable, not a continuously recalculated trail.
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'move the stop-loss to...' (a singular action), not 'continuously trail'.

assumptions.choice: Use intrabar High/Low (not close-only) to test stop-loss, take-profit, and trailing-stop levels.
assumptions.reason: 'Reaches'/'at a level' implies an intrabar touch, consistent with the spec's own touch-based language for the retest condition.

assumptions.choice: When multiple exit conditions coincide on one bar, check in order: stop-loss/trailing stop, then take-profit, then max-holding-period, then retest opportunity.
assumptions.reason: Spec doesn't define precedence for simultaneous conditions; risk controls are checked first as the conservative choice.

assumptions.choice: Count '10 trading days' as 10 distinct calendar-date transitions observed in the 1h feed since the initial breakout fill (not the retest date, not a fixed bar count).
assumptions.reason: Bars-per-day can vary; date-transition counting is the most literal, robust reading of 'trading days' from intraday data.

assumptions.choice: Skip a signaled entry/retest if the computed risk-per-share (|entry-stop|) is zero.
assumptions.reason: Prevents division-by-zero in the position-sizing formula; a numerical safety guard, not an added strategic filter.
